hero.headline: Annnimate grew up.
hero.subtext: Annnimate is now Annnimate by Good Fella. GSAP for React and Vue, where every component carries the landmark site it shipped on - the same library you know, rebuilt around the craft underneath it.

reframe.headline: What changed, and why.
reframe.body: Annnimate started as a GSAP component library. Useful, but it looked like a lot of other things. What it never said out loud is where the components actually came from. We build motion for landmark brand sites at Good Fella, and the best of that work is what fills the library. So we rebuilt Annnimate around it. Every component now carries its provenance - the real site it shipped on. The library is curated harder, the focus is React and Vue, and the whole thing reads like what it is: the motion craft of a working studio, made copyable.

items.label: Provenance on every component.
items.body: Where each one came from: a client brand site, or a Good Fella original built to the same bar.

items.label: React and Vue first.
items.body: Proper framework integration, not wrapped snippets.

items.label: Curated harder.
items.body: Fewer components, every one worth keeping.

items.label: One honest set of pages.
items.body: No contradictions, one refund policy, one voice.

items.label: Landmark Kits, live.
items.body: Deep, stand-alone collections of hard-to-build animations. The first one, Reveal, is out now.
